_comment: Vendor CAD files used to render part sprites (see README.md). 'axes' gives the CAD axis for the part's x (out of the optic's front face), y (your right when facing the optic) and z (up); 'origin_mm' is the CAD point that becomes the part origin. Alignments were measured from each file's mounting holes and bores. 'material' (optional) replaces the file's colours with a renderer material, since Thorlabs STEP files are single-colour. 'hide_above_mm' (optional) drops a lid above that part-frame height so the inside shows. The STEP files themselves are not committed.

KM100CP._note: metric KM100CP/M file: identical body, M4 instead of 8-32 taps

KM100BP._note: origin: pellicle axis (1.05in from the bottom and the +x face) above the bottom #8 hole

KM200BP._note: drawn with its L corner to the lower left: rolled 90 deg; origin: pellicle axis at the depth of the 8-32 taps

BP108._note: origin: membrane centre on the ring's flat (front) face; the relieved face is toward the mount

BP107._note: origin: pellicle axis on the membrane (the ring's front face, behind the clamp tabs); 8-32 tap in the bottom

KB1X1._note: origin: centre of the top face

KB1X1-BOTTOM._note: the KB1X1's bottom plate alone (what stays on the post when the mount is lifted off): same file and frame, top plate hidden

KMSR._note: origin: optic axis (centred between the holder's lips) above the bottom 8-32 tap, mid back plate

M1RMSS._note: plain 10 mm ring along CAD y; origin: axis at the face the objective's shoulder seats on

LMM40X._note: the file's origin is the focus, 7.76 mm in front of the nose; origin here: the shoulder where the RMS thread ends

MAX311D._note: z up, table at z = 0; origin: the 1in grid point the base's counterbored holes fit best (0.8 mm from the base centre)

CP35._note: origin: optic axis on the front face

SM1ZB._note: drawn with the housing down; origin: optic axis at mid-plate (under the top 8-32 hole)

BE02R._note: origin: where the input-port axis meets mirror 1, at beam height; x along the input beam. The lid (above the walls, 14 mm over the beam) is hidden so the mirrors show

PH2._note: origin: post axis on the table; thumbscrew toward +y

PH2@BE1._note: the same PH2 standing on a BE1 (0.185in higher)

CF125C._note: CF125 file: same body as the CF125C minus the captive screw; origin: pedestal centre, heel foot on the table
